# ARKhives 8.21.2

Tiko's complete supplied animation rig remains intact. Animation previews now appear inside the settings window, with the full motion catalog, facial expressions and idle gestures available to explore.

The original neutral resting face restores round blinking eyes. A permanent happy-eye mask no longer overlaps thinking, winking or dizzy spiral eyes. Phone feeds fade through a shallow translucent glass layer behind Tiko instead of meeting a hard edge; dark and light themes stay readable.

Greetings finish before the thinking cue. Thinking and explanation loops return to the original lively idle gestures. Three distinct correct answers trigger the supplied streak celebration; retries and revisiting an answer do not inflate it. Interrupted reactions cannot play an old explanation over a new question.

Remembered companion sounds reconnect on the first tap or keypress after reopening. A visible sound test both enables sounds and plays a sample. Explicit mute settings remain respected, as do reduced-motion preferences.

The latest supplied sound pack is included. Its audio switch now initializes the complete output chain, fixing a silent-playback defect in the supplied revision. Original source files remain untouched.

These are presentation changes shared by desktop and mobile. Answers, saved explanations, question banks, personal progress and learning schedules are preserved. ARKdaily reactions continue to have no effect on study ratings or progress.
